websiteContent.aboutText: Garumara Jatiya Vidyalaya is a premier educational institution established with the mission of providing holistic, high-quality, and affordable education. Situated near the serene Garumara National Park, we nurture young minds with standard curriculum combined with rich cultural values, physical education, and advanced science programs.
websiteContent.principalMessage: Welcome to Garumara Jatiya Vidyalaya. As Principal, it is a privilege to lead this institution dedicated to academic achievement and character building. We believe that education is not merely acquiring knowledge, but molding young characters to face global challenges while remaining rooted in our ethical values. We work hand-in-hand with parents to unlock every child's full potential.

notices.title: Admission Open for Session 2026-27
notices.content: Admissions are open for Classes Lower Kindergarten (LKG) to Class VIII. Online application forms are available on the Admission section. Visit the school office on working days between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM for inquiries.

notices.title: Summer Vacation Notice
notices.content: The school will remain closed for summer vacation from May 20, 2026, to June 15, 2026. Normal classes will resume on June 16, 2026, according to the standard schedule.

leadership.message: Welcome to Garumara Jatiya Vidyalaya. As Principal, it is a privilege to lead this institution dedicated to academic achievement and character building. We believe that education is not merely acquiring knowledge, but molding young characters to face global challenges.

leadership.name: Muzahirul Hoque Anchari
leadership.message: At GJV, we aim to provide an environment where students can discover their true capabilities. I welcome all students and parents to work with us to achieve excellence in all domains of life.

leadership.name: Ahiya Alam
leadership.message: Our curriculum is designed to balance standard academics with creative thinking and physical education. We strive to provide the best tools and pedagogy to guide our students on their educational journey.
